messages:
sana: Heads-up: running into inconsistent return types from embeddings.rerank.batch in the python SDK. Some runs return List[List[float]] and others return List[List[dict]] with keys like 'id'/'score'. Breaking our sample-app tests.

sana: Quick repro (async sample):
```py
resp = await client.embeddings.rerank.batch(queries=["alpha"], docs=[["x","y"]])
# sometimes: [[0.91, 0.05]]
# sometimes: [[{"id":"x","score":0.91},{"id":"y","score":0.05}]]
```

viktor: Which wheel/commit? Could be the retry/auth wrapper returning a parsed body without going through the normalizer.

sana: Using wheel built from main today. Noticed it spikes when token refresh logs appear mid-request.

maya: We had an old helper that turned structured rows into raw scores for backward compat, but it might not be called on the retried codepath. Two options: add a canonicalizer at the public method boundary OR make the server always return scores in the simple API.

viktor: Canonicalizer seems safer. Also we need to adjust type stubs: change return type to List[List[Union[float, Mapping[str, Any]]]] temporarily, and add a boolean flag include_metadata: bool = False to the method so folks can opt-in to dicts. Default remains scores-only.

sana: For now I'll add a tiny helper in examples/utils.py so sample-app can normalize until SDK patch lands: 
```py
def normalize_rerank_rows(rows):
    return [[item.get("score") if isinstance(item, dict) else item for item in row] for row in rows]
```

maya: Good. I'll open a PR that: (1) adds the canonicalizer in client public methods (sync+async), (2) widens the stub + add include_metadata flag, (3) adds unit tests covering both shapes and retry path, (4) updates samples to call normalize helper.

viktor: Add a CHANGELOG note under "Bugfix (python)" and create an issue for backport to 0.9.x. Mark for typing review.

sdk-bot: Issue created: #3512 \u2014 "python: embeddings.rerank.batch inconsistent response shape when retrying". CI started.

sana: Thanks everyone. Once PR lands we'll rerun the onboarding smoke tests and confirm everything passes.

maya: Will ping @viktor for typing review and include a migration note for customers who parse dicts today.
